risk_flags.description: The contract optimizes one suspected in-memory pass but does not commit to measuring or demonstrating that the report command is actually faster from the user's perspective.
risk_flags.span: Can you make the report command faster?

risk_flags.description: The agent excludes disk I/O and JSON parsing, which could plausibly be the real cause of a sluggish command; if so, the delivered change may preserve correctness but not solve the user's problem.
risk_flags.span: No changes to the JSON load/save path (disk I/O and JSON parsing are not addressed)

risk_flags.description: The agent excludes caching between invocations, which may be necessary if repeated report runs are slow because the command reloads or recomputes too much each time.
risk_flags.span: No indexing or caching of the on-disk store between invocations

verdict.primary_risk: The contract does not commit to profiling or command-level performance validation, so it may make a small internal optimization while leaving the perceived sluggishness unchanged.
